tasks.description: Trace feature extraction, graph projection, and Architecture rendering behavior.
Detect source-backed pages, services, cloud functions, APIs, databases, and their chronology.
Derive explicit parent-child application relationships and hierarchy depth.
Apply a constrained D3 force layout with chronological and hierarchical anchors and complexity-aware radii.
Remove depth controls and retain the complete filtered topology while highlighting direct relationships only.
Draw Canvas arrowheads and selection-scoped relationship labels between source-backed parent and child features.
Render Architecture features as complexity-scaled circles with centered category icons and no acronym.
Run syntax checks, focused backend/frontend tests, and the frontend production build.
